data.title: Madinah Chamber Discusses Future of Knowledge Economic City as New Global Destination
data.content:
Madinah, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Al-Madinah Al-Munawarah Chamber organized yesterday the third panel discussion as part of a real estate event featuring a session on Knowledge Economic City as an emerging global destination at Prince Faisal bin Salman Hall at the chamber's headquarters, with the participation of Knowledge Economic City Investment Manager Raafat Wakid.
    The session addressed the major projects being developed by Knowledge Economic City and its plans to establish an integrated global destination combining investment, business, and lifestyle opportunities. These development projects aim to diversify economic activity, enhance the investment environment, and attract investment opportunities across various sectors.
    The session also reviewed the city's investment strategies and its potential to become an attractive destination for investors and entrepreneurs. It highlighted the importance of real estate and development projects in creating an integrated urban environment and strengthening Madinah's position as a hub for investment and development opportunities.
    -- SPA
